description: Mandarin-Vite-React-TS shared component registry. The agent MUST check this before creating any UI structure. Do not invent components not listed here.
scope: Catalogs shared presentational components AND registered feature/domain components (e.g. CharacterHub, HubMnemonicSection, TreeRootNode, BranchNode, PhoneticFamilyNode, ClusterCard, ConstituentCharacterChips) documented in their feature docs/design.md. Other feature containers (components that call hooks/services) live in feature folders only. (Architect decision D1)

Box.description: Generic layout container. Preferred over raw <div> for any container with visual treatment.

as.description: HTML element to render as (div, section, span, etc.)

Button.description: Standardized button with variants, sizes, and loading state.

onKeyDown.description: Keyboard handler forwarded to the underlying <button> (Enter/Space activation).

onKeyUp.description: Keyboard handler forwarded to the underlying <button>.

aria-expanded.description: Exposes expand/collapse state for accordion/tree toggle buttons.

Chip.description: Shared chip with interactive (<button> + aria-pressed + hover/focus-visible) and non-interactive (<span>) modes. Composes glyph/pinyin/label/icon/count slots. No-motion: hover/focus-visible only when interactive; transitions limited to colors.

active.description: Selected/pressed → aria-pressed + active visual (interactive only; purely visual when non-interactive).

children.description: Fallback content when no slots provided

Badge.description: Shared token pill for inline metadata labels (HSK level, tags, counts). Extracted from 3 feature-inlined HSK badge styles (readers, word-hub, phonetic-clusters).

variant.description: Token pill color scheme. primary = bg-primary-bg/text-primary, surface = bg-surface-hover/text-primary, accent = bg-primary-bg-medium/text-primary-light

Input.description: Controlled text input. Always use this instead of raw <input>.

TextLink.description: Inline text-style button that looks like a link. For form-switch actions where Router links won't work.

Card.description: Content card with title, subtitle, optional icon/badge/locked state. The optional badge delegates to the shared Badge component (variant primary).

Modal.description: Controlled overlay dialog with backdrop, close on Escape, size variants.

Tabs.description: Tab navigation bar with panel content slot. Supports default and underline variants.

ProgressBar.description: Progress bar with optional threshold marker.

FilterChip.description: Toggle chip for filter selection; selected state shows a primary tint (bg + border + text) + aria-pressed.

ErrorScreen.description: Full-section error state with retry button.

ClassificationBadge.description: Pill badge displaying a character's classification type (pictograph, phono-semantic, etc.) with emoji and color coding.

classification.description: Classification type; component renders nothing when null/undefined

etymology.description: Etymology text used for pictograph tooltip (optional)

MnemonicCard.description: Classification-aware mnemonic story card. Selects among 4 sub-layouts based on character classification; header shows ClassificationBadge, footer shows regeneration guidance.

character.description: The character glyph the mnemonic is for

classification.description: Character classification (pictograph, phono_semantic, compound_ideograph, simple_ideograph); null falls back to the default layout

radicalIds.description: Radical/component IDs used by phono-semantic and compound layouts

isEdited.description: Shows an '(edited)' tag on the story

onEdit.description: Edit action — renders edit button when provided

onRegenerate.description: Regenerate action — renders regenerate button + guidance tip when provided

isGenerating.description: Shows generating skeleton with 'Creating mnemonic story…'

PictographLayout.description: Layout A — large glyph + etymology + 'Try visualizing' note; optional ancientFormUrl for oracle-bone images.

PhonoSemanticLayout.description: Layout B — two-column meaning clue / sound clue grid splitting radicalIds in half.

CompoundIdeographLayout.description: Layout C — component breakdown with + and → connectors, then the combined character.

SimpleIdeographLayout.description: Layout D — concise explanation + AI story; no columns or component breakdown.

ContentBrowser.description: Full content browsing UI with grid, filters, pagination. The active-filter count badge delegates to the shared Chip component (non-interactive, count slot).

GuestUpsell.description: Presentational sign-in upsell card for guest-gated features. Callers gate on useAuth().isAuthenticated; the card itself has no auth logic and its CTA navigates to the register page by default.

description.description: Supporting copy explaining the registered-user benefit

icon.description: Leading emoji/icon glyph shown before the title

to.description: Route to navigate to on CTA click

Icon.description: Lucide-wrapped shared icon (ADR-010/Q8). Explicit name→component map (currentColor, 1.5px stroke, 16–24px). Decorative by default (aria-hidden); role=img + <title> when a label is provided. Emoji is banned as an icon once a surface is covered.

name.description: Sanctioned icon name from the explicit map in Icon.tsx

label.description: Accessible label → role=img + <title>. Omit for decorative.

EmptyState.description: Iconographic empty state (Tier-0 vibrancy, 2B.1 d). Precision-minimal: optional decorative icon, title, description, and action slot. Presentational only.

action.description: Action slot — typically one secondary Button

LockedSurface.description: Shared locked-surface gate fallback (Epic 25 S2) — neutral, CTA-free screen shown on below-phase direct Learn-route nav (guest or authed). Replaces the silent redirect-to-foundations. Data-driven via label/requiredPhase; composes EmptyState (lock icon) mirroring the SideNav locked-item treatment. CTA/value-moment stays out (epic-26 GuestUpsell).

label.description: Content label of the locked surface (e.g. "Grammar")

requiredPhase.description: Phase required to unlock the surface (from LEARN_REQUIRED_PHASE)

SideNav.description: Side navigation panel. Nav-only (auth lives in the AppTopBar UserMenu); phase-gated Learn group + desktop collapsed rail.

phaseGate.description: Current user phase for lock logic

requiredPhase.description: Maps a Learn child id to the phase required to unlock it

UserMenu.description: Single account control (login/user-info/logout) — avatar trigger + popover (Profile/Settings/Logout); guest state = Login/Register CTAs. Hosted in the AppTopBar.

AppTopBar.description: Slim global top bar hosting the UserMenu on the right; auth threaded in via props (AppLayout → AppTopBar → UserMenu). When isGuest, renders a compact passive Guest badge next to the account controls (Epic 25 S1 — no CTA; upsell is epic-26).

isGuest.description: Renders the passive Guest identity badge when true (driven by AppLayout from useAuth/usePhaseGate)

PageHeader.description: Precision-minimal page header (hub-launcher). Renders the page's single <h1> with optional eyebrow, description, and a top-right CTA slot (≤1 primary Button). No border, no background.

CharacterStrokePlayer.description: Stroke animation player for Chinese characters. Mini mode for embedding (hub), full mode for dedicated stroke practice.

placeholderSize.description: Font utility class for placeholder character

CharacterHub.description: Character Detail Hub overlay — modal with character info, stroke animation, audio, radicals, and actions.

HubCharacterCard.description: Character hero card with stroke player, pinyin, and audio button.

HubActions.description: Action buttons: Save to Review + Mark Learned.

HubRadicalSection.description: Phase-gated radical decomposition with skeleton loading and styled empty state.

HubIdentityCard.description: NORTH zone identity card: glyph, pinyin, meaning, badges, etymology. Metadata badges delegate to the shared Badge component (variant surface).

HubReadings.description: All readings with pinyin, tone, audio, and frequency rank.

HubCommonWords.description: Clickable chips for common compound words containing the character.

AnimationCanvas.description: Canvas-based animation container for stroke order visualization.

TopNav.description: Top-level navigation bar with route-based NavLinks. Phase-gated lock support.

Textarea.description: Controlled multiline text input. Always use this instead of raw <textarea>.

HubMnemonicSection.description: Feature component — Phase-gated mnemonic story section for CharacterHub. Displays, generates, and edits AI-powered mnemonic stories.

TreeRootNode.description: Radical tree root node — a mastered radical with expandable character branches. Tree EXCEPTION: chevron rotate(90deg) + grid-rows expand/collapse animation (documented in DESIGN.md). The character-count pill delegates to the shared Chip component (non-interactive, count slot).

characters.description: Character branches rendered as BranchNode rows

BranchNode.description: Character branch node in the radical mastery tree — horizontal row with glyph, pinyin, meaning, audio button, and Hub link. Tree EXCEPTION: ::before rail + corner connector tree lines (documented in DESIGN.md).

showConnector.description: Render tree connector lines via ::before/connector spans

PhoneticFamilyNode.description: Expandable phonetic family node — phonetic glyph, pinyin, meaning, character count, and expandable member list with ClassificationBadge. Tree EXCEPTION: arrow rotate(90deg) + border-left member rail (documented in DESIGN.md).

family.description: Phonetic family data (phoneticPattern, pinyin, description, members, memberCount)

ClusterCard.description: Phonetic cluster card — large pattern glyph, pinyin/description, pronunciation note, HSK badges (shared Badge accent variant), a member character grid using the shared Chip component (interactive, opens hub), and a member-count chip using the shared Chip component (non-interactive, count slot).

ConstituentCharacterChips.description: Character chips for a word's constituent characters. Each chip is the shared Chip component (interactive, surface variant) — glyph + pinyin + meaning — and opens the Character Detail Hub via openHub.

characters.type: Array<{ glyph: string; pinyin: string; meaning: string }>

rules: Do NOT invent component variants not listed here
Do NOT use raw <div> when Box can be used
Do NOT use raw <button> when Button can be used
Do NOT use raw <input> when Input can be used
Always prefer existing shared components from registry over creating new ones
